messages:
lina: quick sync — finalizing the subscriber reactivation playbook. goal: tie the benchmark webinar + new benchmark report into a 3-email stack. target segments: lapsed trialers (30–90d), low-eng newsletter cohort, and churn-risk accounts. want routing + utm + basic acceptance criteria before sends.
omar: do we have segment counts? we need to estimate ESP throttling and expected bounces.
tara: i pulled raw counts: trialers=2,140, low-eng=8,910, churn-risk=432. total ~11,482 — after suppressions expect ~9.8k.
jeff: subject line A/B ideas: A) "New benchmark: inference that lowers your bill" B) "See how teams cut 60% off inference costs"
lina: i like B but keep it specific and defensible — maybe keep the percent vague unless we have a public stat. B alt: "How teams cut costs on inference"
omar: routing question — which leads go to SDR vs automated flows? propose: any org with >50 seats OR prior demo request -> SDR. Open+click+company-size>20 -> sales-touch. rest -> automated 5-day drip.
tara: flow sketch (send cadence):
```
Day 0: webinar invite + benchmark (subject A/B)
Day 3: reminder + short case study
Day 7: gated benchmark report (CTA: download)
If clicked/downloaded -> qualification check -> route to SDR if matches rules
Else -> re-engage light drip (2 emails over 14 days)
```
jeff: UTM template: utm_campaign=reactivate_q2_benchmark & utm_source=newsletter & utm_medium=email. Also include utm_content for subject variant.
lina: suppression rules: exclude anyone emailed in last 14 days and anyone marked do-not-contact. double-check global unsub list. send windows: wed 10:00 PT vs thu 14:00 PT for A/B.
omar: i'll build the SQL for the segments and a send estimate. i'll add rate-limits for the ESP (2k/hr) and queue if > threshold.
tara: personalization tokens to include: {{first_name}}, {{company_name}}, {{last_active_days}}. we should also try dynamic CTA text for enterprise vs startup.
jeff: copy approval flow? who signs off on subject and body?
lina: i'll approve final copy. tara -> QA templates and links. omar -> confirm segment SQL + suppression set. jeff -> finalize tracking + analytics plan.
mailer-bot: draft saved: "reactivate_q2_benchmark_v1" and queued for review at 1719123600.
omar: posting SQL snippets in #eng-marketing in 10m. i'll include example filters (trial_start_date, last_login, invite_sent_at null).
tara: i'll QA once templates are in staging. aiming to start the A/B send on Wednesday. will post final send times and counts in this thread. :thumbsup:
jeff: quick ask — can we add a tiny survey in email 3 for reason-for-inactivity? 1–2 options max.
lina: yes, keep it one-question, optional. good idea for signal. :rocket:
tara: noted — adding the micro-survey and a fallback CTA to watch the webinar recording. moving to QA now, will report back with final numbers within 24h.
